t: This is Arsenal tube station, in Highbury, on the Piccadilly line between Holloway Road and Finsbury Park. It's in fare zone 2. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is known for the stations he built across central London in the early 1900s, with oxblood red faïence blocks, pillars, semi-circular first-floor windows, and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style. Green lived from 1875 to 1908, so his career was short, but his station designs are among the best-known on the Underground.
